_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX Account Info master 790:14793. The master is 2 stacked variants: 790:14816 single-row chip (320×47) + 790:15115 detail panel (350×528). The detail panel embeds 8 INSTANCEs of the chip via figma's INSTANCE id-namespacing (I790:15049;790:14780 etc.) — figma authors each instance text with the master's placeholder copy unless overridden ('收款账户号' label keeps the master label for the namespaced text; values vary). The Linear/Essentional/UI/Copy 24×24 icon (2 figma VECTORs drawing a clipboard-glyph) is mass-waived in iconDeviations because pixel-perfect SVG paths come from figma-exported assets we haven't yet converted to react-native-svg components (tool-bandwidth physical reason, same precedent as account-card-master 258:758 / button-master / dialogs). checkTextContainerStyle is false — figma authors text directly on TEXT nodes with no surrounding container fill drift here.
_fontAliasNote: Figma master labels CJK as 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; the app ships HarmonyOS Sans SC + PlusJakartaSans-* — same family alias contract as account-card-master.
